answer: Random peer audit blocks bulk fakes. Each epoch a beacon picks auditors; every agent is a vertex in the graph, and auditors re-run a sample of its work and check its counterparties. Identities wandering between services with no real work fail and forfeit a 20 POA bond, the verdict is permanent as ivory. Forging 100 fakes risks 2,000 POA, 90 failing per epoch; one honest agent posts one 20 POA bond, passes by real work, keeps earnings undiluted.
